title: The Mojo language (by Modular, now Qualcomm) is now open-source
summary: Modular (now owned by Qualcomm) has open-sourced the Mojo programming language, which was designed to combine Python's accessibility with systems-level performance for AI and machine learning workloads.
problem_solved: Bridges the gap between Python's developer productivity and the performance demands of AI/ML workloads by providing a Python-compatible language with C-like speed.
why_valuable: Opens up a promising new language that could democratize high-performance AI programming while maintaining Python ecosystem compatibility.
